items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and retain only the existing report-only finance reconciliation. Do not admit new work, requeues, deployments, telemetry, dependencies, spend, or monetization expansion while delivery is full at 10/10 slots, with 60 overflow items, 38 improvements awaiting measurement, and 17 failed requests. Financial claims are limited: Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only—6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission, including 629 clicks in an aggregate provider row. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites; named site-attributed commission is $0 in the available snapshot. September 1–29 AI usage is $934.99756275 across 5,174 calls with 229 errors, but it cannot be compared to the one-day revenue period or used to forecast monthly revenue, margin, ROI, payback, or cost-to-learn. Budget exposure is unknown because monthly spend, fixed costs, marketing budget, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Infrastructure spend is unknown because operations sweeps have no results and no infrastructure-cost ledger is supplied. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, and financial return are therefore not calculable. Minimum measurement remains a period-aligned reconciliation of provider rows to site/content outcomes plus matching-period AI, infrastructure, labor, operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and an approved learning threshold. Push back on proposal execution rate, clicks, impressions, sessions, and shipped output as productivity or financial outcomes; they do not establish revenue or margin. Continue the existing CFO work item only; preserve all unavailable values as unknown and do not extrapolate.
